div.head: IV Eg 14
div.ab: Mid Anglum ic hæbbe gecoren ⁊ mine witan, hwæt seo steor beon mæge, gif ænig man mid ánbyrdnysse beginð oððe mid ealle ofslyhð ænige þara þe ymbe þas smeagunge bið ⁊ þæt dyrne orf ameldað, oððe þara ænigne þe on soðre gewitnesse bið [⁊] mid his soðe þæne unscyldigan ahret ⁊ ðæne scyldigan rihtlice fordeð.

I and my councillors have determined what the penalty shall be among the English, if any man ventures to offer resistance or slays outright anyone who is engaged in this operation and who gives notice of the concealed cattle, or anyone who is giving true witness and, by his veracity, saves the innocent and brings just doom upon the guilty.

Mid Anglum ic hæbbe gecoren ⁊ mine witan, hwæt seo steor beon mæge, gif ænig man mid ánbyrdnysse beginð oððe mid ealle ofslyhð ænigne þara þe ymbe þás smeagunge bið ⁊ þæt dyrne orf ámeldað, oþþe þara ænigne þe on soðre gewitnesse bið ⁊ mid his soðe þæne unscyldigean ahret ⁊ þæne scyldigean rihtlice fordeð.
